goals.description: Seconds into the second half, Jacen Russell-Rowe took Aron Dønnum's pass on the right side of the box and curled a left-footed shot into the top left corner.
Aron Dønnum doubled Toulouse's lead with a left-footed finish from the centre of the box into the bottom right corner.
Casper Tengstedt, who had an earlier goal ruled out by VAR, turned in Cristian Cásseres Jr.'s pass from very close range into the bottom right corner.

var.detail: Goal ruled out after VAR review (score stayed 0-2).

matches.notes: Attendance not published by ESPN (0) or found elsewhere - null. Referee from LFP designations; coaches from Wikipedia season page. Goal types inferred from ESPN commentary. Shot y mirrored from ESPN so 0 = attacker's left.

goals.description: Shortly after a spell of Strasbourg corners, Giovanni Reyna received from Gessime Yassine on the right side of the box and finished left-footed into the bottom right corner.
From a PSG corner, Ousmane Dembélé's delivery found Illia Zabarnyi, who equalised with a right-footed shot from the centre of the box into the bottom left corner.
Ousmane Dembélé, who had missed a penalty at 72', put PSG ahead with a left-footed shot from the centre of the box into the bottom left corner.
In stoppage time Ferran Torres set up Désiré Doué, who sealed the win with a right-footed shot from the centre of the box into the bottom left corner.

var.detail: Penalty awarded to PSG after VAR review for a handball by Pape Diop; Ousmane Dembélé missed it at 72'.

matches.notes: Attendance not found - null. Reyna's goal came one minute after a Strasbourg corner sequence; not flagged as from the corner in ESPN, typed as build. Dembélé missed a VAR-awarded penalty at 72'. Shot y mirrored from ESPN.

goals.description: From an early Brest corner, Gautier Lloris's blocked effort fell for Mama Baldé, who finished from the centre of the box into the bottom left corner.
After Bradley Locko fouled Ethan Mbappé in the area, Olivier Giroud converted the penalty with his left foot into the top left corner.

matches.notes: Attendance not found - null. ESPN does not specify the foot for Mama Baldé's finish (foot null). Shot y mirrored from ESPN.

goals.description: From a Lens corner, after efforts from Jean-Clair Todibo and Ruben Aguilar, the ball went in off Troyes defender Adrien Monfray.
Moments after Robin Risser saved Antoine Mille's long-range shot, Timothé Nkada equalised with a left-footed finish from the left side of the six-yard box.
On a fast break in first-half stoppage time, Florian Thauvin crossed for Odsonne Édouard, who shot right-footed from the centre of the box into the middle of the goal.
Lens broke quickly again and Florian Thauvin's cross was headed in by Ruben Aguilar from the right side of the six-yard box.

matches.notes: ESPN lists venue city as Paris; corrected to Troyes (Stade de l'Aube). Attendance not found - null. Édouard goal at 45+2 stored as 45. Nkada's goal followed a saved Mille shot; whether it was a direct rebound is not stated. Shot y mirrored from ESPN.

goals.description: Lilian Raolisoa gave Angers the lead with a header from the left side of the six-yard box into the bottom left corner.
Timothy Weah crossed and Himad Abdelli headed in from very close range to equalise.
From a Marseille corner, Emerson's cross was headed into the bottom left corner by Nouhoum Kamissoko from the centre of the box.
A minute after Anthony Lopes saved his penalty, Amine Gouiri scored from the centre of the box after a set-piece situation, shooting right-footed into the bottom left corner.
After Tochukwu Nnadi fouled Carlens Arcus in the area, Amine El Ouazzani converted the penalty left-footed into the bottom left corner.
Amine Harit took Tochukwu Nnadi's pass and struck a right-footed shot from outside the box into the bottom right corner.
Timothy Weah's headed pass set up Igor Paixão, who finished right-footed from the centre of the box into the bottom right corner.

matches.notes: Attendance not found - null. Raolisoa's header came two minutes after an Angers free kick; delivery not confirmed, typed as build. Gouiri had a penalty saved at 59' before scoring at 60'. Shot y mirrored from ESPN.

goals.description: Danny Namaso opened the scoring for Auxerre, finishing Kévin Danois's pass right-footed from the right side of the six-yard box.
Romain Faivre's through ball sent Danny Namaso clear and he slotted a right-footed shot from the centre of the box into the bottom left corner.
On a fast break, substitute Hakim Dongopandji set up fellow substitute Rayan Fofana, who scored right-footed from the centre of the box.
Romain Faivre settled the game with a right-footed shot from outside the box into the bottom right corner after a pass from Danny Namaso.

matches.notes: Attendance not found - null. Namaso's first goal came right after a Le Havre attack (Maja shot saved), possibly a counter, but ESPN does not say so; typed as build. Shot y mirrored from ESPN.

goals.description: After Denis Zakaria fouled in the area, Noah Cadiou converted the penalty right-footed into the bottom right corner for the only goal.

matches.notes: Attendance not found - null. Only goal a penalty conceded by Denis Zakaria (the fouled player is not named by ESPN). Shot y mirrored from ESPN.

goals.description: Maxime López opened the scoring with a right-footed shot from the centre of the box after a pass from Lassine Sinayoko.
Estéban Lepaul was fouled in the box by Pierre Lees-Melou and converted the penalty himself into the bottom left corner.
Deep in first-half stoppage time, Lassine Sinayoko set up Maxime López, who scored his second from very close range.
After Samir Chergui fouled Mousa Al-Tamari in the box, Estéban Lepaul again converted from the spot into the bottom left corner.
Lassine Sinayoko restored Paris FC's lead with a left-footed shot from the centre of the box into the bottom right corner.
Following a handball by Otávio in the area, Estéban Lepaul completed his hat-trick of penalties, this time into the bottom right corner.
After a VAR review awarded a penalty for a foul on Lassine Sinayoko, he converted it right-footed in the 97th minute to win the game.

var.detail: Goal ruled out after VAR review (score stayed 2-1).
Penalty awarded to Paris FC after VAR review for a foul on Sinayoko; he converted it at 90+7.

matches.notes: Attendance not found - null. López's 45+4 goal stored as 45 and Sinayoko's 90+7 penalty as 90. Lepaul scored three penalties. Szymanski goal (51') disallowed by VAR. Shot y mirrored from ESPN.

goals.description: Jonathan Clauss crossed and Elye Wahi finished right-footed from the centre of the box into the bottom left corner.
Moments after Yehvann Diouf saved from Julien Duranville, Pavel Sulc equalised from very close range.
From a set-piece situation, Zachary Athekame crossed and Tanner Tessmann headed in from the centre of the box.

var.detail: Stoppage-time goal ruled out after VAR review (score stayed 2-1).

matches.notes: Attendance not found - null. Keito Nakamura (sub at 61') sent off at 70' straight after a foul; exact reason not given by ESPN. Wahi's stoppage-time goal disallowed by VAR, then he was booked for excessive celebration. Shot y mirrored from ESPN.
